name: neural-gene-matched-normal-2026-06-08
title: t221(c) evidence-derived matched_normal_studies classification for config-full
description: Classifies each full-config study as patient-matched-normal via per-variant normal-barcode patient-stem match (stem_match >= 0.50). High-precision lower bound; matched-by-design cohorts that do not record a per-variant normal barcode (MSK-IMPACT family, tcga_mc3) are reported separately, not auto-added.
